title: RBAC v2: enforce KMS region residency and audit logging enhancements
author: Ava Patel
description:
Motivation: Harden RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS-backed keys by ensuring region residency constraints are enforced at policy evaluation time and that audit logs capture KMS key usage with region metadata. This PR adds enforcement checks, improves audit log payloads, and wires the feature behind a gradual rollout flag.

Summary of changes: - Add KMS region residency enforcement to RBAC v2 policy engine (policy rule KMS_REGION_RESIDENCY). - Emit structured audit events with kms_key_id, kms_region, requesting_principal, and decision_reason for all KMS-related operations. - Add migration that annotates existing keys in metadata store with inferred region when possible. - Config-driven rollout: 0.0 -> 1.0 percent rollout via feature flag rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce. - Backwards compatibility: enforcement defaults off for Dedicated/Private customers until tenancy opt-in.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for policy evaluation and audit serializer. - [x] Integration tests against the KMS emulator and region mismatch cases. - [x] Migration and safe rollback path. - [x] Observability: dashboards and alerts updated. - [x] Docs PR reference: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-docs/pull/482

Notes: See Linear ENG-4821 for design doc and test plan. This change is security-sensitive; reviewers should verify audit payload fields and policy evaluation order. Rollout plan included at the end of the description.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag defaulted to 0%. 2) Enable for internal staging and run smoke tests for 48h. 3) Gradually ramp to 10% on main, monitor audit logs and policy rejects. 4) After 7 days with no regressions, enable for all hosted accounts and coordinate Dedicated/Private opt-ins via account support flow.
